note: Owner ruling 2026-10-29: US federal publications (GPO/govinfo, USPTO patents, NARA press releases) may display. The adversary refuted the record because the public-domain statement is the publisher's site-wide notice (17 U.S.C. 105 on govinfo; the USPTO terms of use), not a line on the item page; the ruling covers exactly that question.
